description: This file defines the LangException class, a custom exception class extending PHP's Exception class within the SuiteCRM namespace. It is specific to error handling related to language message components and integrates with the LangText class, which appears to handle localized text messages.

classes.name: LangException
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling language-related errors within SuiteCRM, with support for localized messages.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with optional message, code, previous exception, and a LangText object for localized messaging.

methods.name: getLangMessage
methods.description: Retrieves the localized message text if available.
